title: States of Matter & the Particle Model
summary: Solids, liquids and gases are made of the same kind of particles, just arranged and moving differently.

ib.note: Particle model is revisited and deepened in MYP 3

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 7: Particulate Nature of Matter
Earlier NCERT: Matter in Our Surroundings (states of matter; not in Exploration 2026)

objectives: I can state the three main ideas of the particle model.
I can describe the arrangement and movement of particles in solids, liquids and gases.
I can use the particle model to explain properties such as shape, flow and compressibility.
misconceptions: Particles in a solid do not move at all.
There is air (or something) in the gaps between particles.
Particles of a substance change size or shape in different states.
